name: How long does an AI Technical Audit typically take to complete?
description: The duration of an AI Technical Audit depends on system complexity, ranging from 2-4 weeks for smaller setups to 6-12 weeks or more for larger enterprises.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI Technical Audit typically take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an AI Technical Audit varies significantly depending on the complexity and scale of your AI infrastructure. For smaller, less complex systems, an audit might be completed within 2-4 weeks. Larger enterprises with multiple AI models, extensive data pipelines, or intricate integrations could require 6-12 weeks, or even longer. Factors like data availability, documentation quality, and internal team responsiveness also influence the timeline. A detailed scope discussion at the outset helps provide a more accurate estimate.
